name: Vantage

categories.label: Destiny completed
categories.hint: One of the destiny goals (e.g. escaping the planet) completed

winCondition: Mission or destiny completed gives mission/destiny victory; both give epic victory. Mission completion permits continued play. Ending a destiny requires choosing to read its entry. At zero time/morale/health follow the mission TAKE entry; a final chance is ordinarily available once. Record the actual session outcome, without points.

endCondition.description: Mission or destiny completed gives mission/destiny victory; both give epic victory. Mission completion permits continued play. Ending a destiny requires choosing to read its entry. At zero time/morale/health follow the mission TAKE entry; a final chance is ordinarily available once. Record the actual session outcome, without points.

notes: Cooperative outcome only, no numeric VP. Guided inputs derive mission/destiny/epic victory only after the session is marked ended. Intrinsic success can remain a play note; storybook instructions and player choices are not automated.
